mentions.name: Himalayan Database website
mentions.description: A website that makes The Himalayan Database of detailed mountaineering expedition records more accessible and easier to browse, built in collaboration with the organization behind it.
mentions.problem: The Himalayan Database's expedition records are available as a download but awkward to browse.
mentions.source_excerpt: The data is available in a downloadable format, but it is a little awkward to browse. I have been working in collaboration with them to build a website for making the database more accessible https://himalayan-database.climbing-history.org/
